sentences.text: This criminal revision is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A. No.18478/2019, which is an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant.

This criminal revision under section 397/401 of the Code of Crimi- nal Procedure has been preferred against the judgment dated 23/09/2019 passed by the Additional Session Judge, Satna, in Criminal Appeal No.216/2014 confirming the judgment dated 10/06/2014 passed by JMFC, Satna in Criminal Case No.1596/2013, and whereby the appli- cant has been convicted under section 7(i) read with section 16(i)(A)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to 6 months R.I with fine of Rs.1000/- and in default 2 months S.I as mentioned in the impugned order.
Considering the argument advanced by the parties, and on perusal of record of trial court, in view of this Court the applicant is entitled to get suspension of sentence.

It is or- dered that subject to payment of fine amount, if not already deposited, the execution of jail sentence of the applicant Ramlal Gupta shall re- Ramlal Gupta vs State Of Madhya Pradesh on 3 December, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44155844/
1 main suspended during the pendency of this revision and he be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs.
Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court on 18/02/2020 and thereafter on all other such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Court in this regard during the pendency of the revision.
